image_prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Create ONE standalone educational scene illustration, square 1024x1024. Pure SOLID BLACK background, bright clean WHITE line art. Minimalist adult stick figures with circular heads, simple expressive faces, thin limbs, polished programmer workplace comic aesthetic. No colors, gradients, shading or photographic rendering. Single coherent scene, no panels. People and props central, approximately x=180..820 and y=220..790 on 0..1000 canvas. Generous blank space at top y<180, bottom y>850 and sides for later learning labels. Learning props recognizable and fully visible. Conversation gestures. NO speech bubbles, letters, numbers, captions, logos, watermark, readable code or writing. Simple abstract UI symbols allowed. Scene: Two adult stick-figure developers sit across a small desk comparing TWO physical smartphones. Left person holds one phone vertically; RIGHT person holds a second phone upright away from their torso, entire phone outline and screen clearly visible. Each screen has the same single blank rectangular tile; no data, digits or text. Calm explanatory gestures, no arrows between devices. Right phone is a distinct recognizable physical handset, easy to crop.
